note: Track breath, steps 6 and 8 (a long breath out): one breathwork circle with the "long-exhale" drill, at its own lengths (in for 4, out for 8) for intermediate and set to its longest breath out ("seconds": 16, six rounds) for advanced; the title's length param says which. The text follows the circle and names the control that runs it again, and the feel to reach is an even flow to the end of the breath. Folds in voice-advanced-a-long-breath-out as the advanced choice.

exercise.title: A long breath out, {{=length}}
exercise.why: A long phrase is one slow breath out, so a breath out much longer than the breath in is the phrase without its notes.

cells.text:
Press Start in the circle below. Breathe in while the circle grows, then let the air out slowly until it is small again.
When the rounds are done, press Again in the circle to run them once more.
Spend the air slowly from the very start of the breath out, so some is left for the end.
Practice until the air flows as evenly at the end of the breath out as at the start.
